name: FedEx Express Regional Hub - Greensboro NC

fieldNotes.location: FedEx Express Mid-Atlantic regional air hub on the secured airside of Piedmont Triad International Airport (GSO), Greensboro NC. Roster geocode (36.1043,-79.9838) landed ~4 km west on unrelated warehouses; corrected via web research (hub opened June 2009, ~1M sq ft, 24,000 pkg/hr) and satellite confirmation of the main sort building plus aircraft apron.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No street-level imagery of a dedicated FedEx truck gate is available — the hub sits inside the airport AOA, so vehicle access is controlled at airport-wide SIDA security checkpoints rather than a single FedEx booth. Marked truckGate=true (controlled access exists) but this is an airport-security control, not a typical yard gate; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No discrete FedEx guard booth identified at a property entrance in satellite imagery; airport AOA access is badge/credential controlled, hence remoteGs=true rather than guardShack.
fieldNotes.multiStep: Airport access (perimeter security) followed by FedEx ramp control implies a multi-stage entry, but no second booth is directly visible — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Counted ~25-50 landside cargo dock positions along the southwest face of the sort building (canopied bays); airside cargo wings handle container-to-aircraft transfer. Estimate from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Feeder trailers parked along apron/dock edge; ~10-25 trailer positions visible. Approximate.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus has the main sort building, a separate NW office building, and airside cargo wings — multiple distinct structures.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale visible on airport property.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.streetView: Available Street View on adjacent airport service roads (2015/2023 panos) shows only open field/airport land; the hub interior is not street-accessible.
